what: In the opening curtain covering the screen, a video fitted to the window width (one of the wide-screen or phone versions) plays once silently. When the video ends, or Skip (SKIP) is pressed, or 10 seconds pass, the whole curtain disappears with 1.5s sine.inOut (jQuery fadeOut swing) and fires fx:done. The skip button sits at the bottom right (bottom center on phones) and half-fades in .3s on hover

options.[data-fx-part=video]: Cover video (autoplay muted playsinline) — for phones, data-key="narrow"
options.max: Seconds before advancing even if the video hasn’t ended, default 10
options.narrow: Below this width (px) the window uses the phone video, default 601

note: Video length is the waiting time. On screens that are skipped often, shorten out and max, or attach it only on the first visit

from.where: index.html .kb-loader (original loading.min.js — video 8s, PC 1440:1024 · phone 390:844, fadeOut 1500 swing on ended · SKIP · 10s)
